evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Plain unhedged assertion of what the test does — asserted and ready to defend, but no ratification or operational settling language to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Operational rule stated as a settled requirement the speaker expects to hold — 'must not' / 'must produce' performs the settling, not merely arguing for it.

mints.name: OperationalMustRule
mints.title: must not / must produce — requirement stated as settled operational rule
mints.frame: Is the conviction here performed as a settled operational rule the speaker expects others to act on, rather than as a position still being argued for?
